name: flow-authoring
summary: Interview the owner about a process, draft it as a flow, validate it, dry-run an agent through it in a sandbox, record the eval, and adopt it.

phases.name: interview
phases.instruction: Interview the owner about the process in rounds of at most three questions. Write Process (the phases in order), Roles (who acts in each), Gates (what must exist before each phase ends, and who provides it), Stops (where an unattended agent must stop) and Rule map (one line per rule the owner stated, naming the check that will enforce it, or saying no check kind can and why). Play the summary back and ask the owner to sign a decision whose refs name the plan.

checks.remedy: Only the owner can confirm the interview: play the plan's summary back to him and ask him to sign a plans/decision/v1 whose refs name {plan}, then attach it with `board call changes.attach --path {change} --ref <decision>`. Running without him, record the question and stop.

phases.name: draft
phases.instruction: Write the flow as a changes/flow/v1 at /changes/{name}/draft with `board put`, one check per line of the Rule map, each check that the owner or a reviewer passes with a remedy that tells an unattended agent how to ask. Attach it with `board call changes.attach --path {change} --ref /changes/{name}/draft`.

phases.name: dry-run
phases.instruction: Start an eval with the evals skill, naming the draft as its subject. Run `board call changes.run --flow /changes/{name}/draft --sandbox true --mount <the mount the flow is for, or /> --title '<a small sample task>'`, which runs an agent through the draft in a throwaway copy of the board and the repository, copies its run and stop records to {change}, and attaches the run. Check that it stopped where the Stops section says, that each gate refused what it should, and that each remedy was enough to act on. Attach the eval and conclude it.

phases.name: adopt
phases.instruction: Ask the owner to sign a decision whose refs name the draft and the eval. Then copy the draft to /flows/{draft} with `board put`, and point /flows/repos/<repo> or /flows/default at it if the owner chose that.

checks.remedy: Only the owner can adopt the flow: ask him to sign a plans/decision/v1 whose refs name the draft and the eval, then attach it with `board call changes.attach --path {change} --ref <decision>`. Running without him, record the question and stop.
